run.description: Full resolve run of the Campus Customs board after resetting data/campus_customs_new.db to original.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee (customer order)
tickets.short_outcome: Size S was out of stock (0 on hand) and the reprint vendor (Bulldog Print Co) was blocked by an open unpaid invoice #501. The human approved paying invoice #501 ($840), which unblocked the vendor, and approved a 1-unit reprint purchase order (ETA 2026-09-05). Ticket closed.

agents.boss: Read the ticket and routed it to inventory, then made the final call and closed the ticket.
agents.inventory: Checked stock (CC-TEE-WHITE/S = 0 vs 1 requested), matched vendor 1 (apparel reprint, 5-day lead), found vendor 1 blocked by open unpaid invoice #501, and delegated to accounting.
agents.accounting: Confirmed cash ($3,400), read invoice #501 ($840), checked pricing, and prepared the invoice-#501 payment plus a 1-unit tee restock purchase order for human approval.

human_approvals.note: no cash moves until the vendor invoices for this reprint

tickets.subject: Rent due (rent notice)
tickets.short_outcome: Chapel Street shop rent of $2,400 (lease 1) was due 2026-09-02 (two days out). Accounting prepared the rent payment; the human approved it and it was paid from checking. Ticket closed.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, routed it to facilities, and made the final call.
agents.facilities: Read lease 1 (Chapel Street shop, $2,400/mo, due 2026-09-02), judged it due soon vs today, and delegated to accounting to prepare the rent payment.
agents.accounting: Confirmed cash and prepared the $2,400 rent payment (affordable; would leave $160) for human approval.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount (price override)
tickets.short_outcome: Yale AI Club asked for a bulk discount on 20 navy hoodies. Accounting checked the margin (list $58 vs cost $22 = $36 / 62.1% per unit). The ticket did not state a discount amount, so no price was changed or promised; the request was left as a recommendation for a human pricing decision and the ticket was closed. No cash moved.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, routed it to accounting, and made the final call (awaiting a human pricing decision, then closed).
agents.accounting: Checked CC-HOOD-NAVY pricing and reported the $36 (62.1%) per-unit margin; noted the discount amount was unspecified so its impact couldn't be assessed, and that no price-change tool exists — this is a human decision.

tickets.note: Leaner than the Problem 6 plan (which anticipated inventory for the 12-unit shortfall and a customer-service draft). This run the team resolved it as a pure margin/pricing recommendation with no money movement, so no restock PO or payment was prepared.
